premiums increased commendably by 20% from KShs.6.2 b in 2016 to KShs.7.5 b in 2017 as our strategy on diversification takes hold. • Investment and other income increased by 54% from Kshs.1.28 b to Kshs.1.97 b partly because our investments on the NSE have begun to recover as per our projections. • Claims incurred increased by 27% from Kshs.3.2 b to Kshs.4.1 b in line with business growth and prudent reserving. • Profit before tax increased by 28% to Kshs.430 m. • The Uganda business is on track and it’s topline growth is making a mark in the market. • Although the South Sudan economy is slowly getting back to normal, the economic environment still remains hyperinflationary. • Efforts continue to grow the business in Malawi with increased support from insurance brokers and cooperatives. WAY FORWARD The Group has registered commendable growth during a challenging period, with key focus areas being: growth and diversification of revenue streams, consolidating local and regional presence, innovation and information technology.
